source: AKTU BTech 2nd Year Computer Science & Allied Evaluation Scheme & Syllabus, effective session 2023-24; supplied PDF docs/Syllabus_merged.pdf

units.title: Introduction, Arrays and Linked Lists
topics: Basic terminology and elementary data organization
Built in data types in C
Algorithms, efficiency, time and space complexity
Asymptotic notations: Big Oh, Big Theta and Big Omega
Time-space trade-off and Abstract Data Types (ADT)
Arrays: definition, single and multidimensional arrays
Row Major Order and Column Major Order; array index formulae
Array applications and sparse matrix representations
Singly, doubly and circular linked lists

units.title: Stacks and Queues
topics: Stack ADT; push and pop operations
Array and linked stack implementation in C
Prefix and postfix expressions; postfix evaluation
Iteration, recursion, tail recursion and recursion removal
Binary search, Fibonacci numbers and Hanoi towers
Array and linked queue implementation in C

units.title: Searching, Hashing and Sorting
topics: Sequential search and index sequential search

units.title: Trees
topics: Array and pointer representations of binary trees
Binary search trees; strictly binary and complete binary trees
Binary search tree insertion, deletion, searching and modification
AVL trees, B trees and binary heaps

units.title: Graphs
topics: Graph terminology and adjacency matrix/list representations
Depth First Search (DFS) and Breadth First Search (BFS)
Minimum cost spanning trees: Prim's and Kruskal's algorithms

units.title: Computer Organization and Data Representation
topics: Functional units of a digital system and interconnections
Bus architecture, bus types and bus arbitration

units.title: Arithmetic and Logic Unit
topics: Array multiplier, division and logic operations

units.title: Control Unit and Pipelining
topics: Program control and Reduced Instruction Set Computer (RISC)
Microprogram sequencing; horizontal and vertical microprogramming

units.title: Memory Organization
topics: Cache memories: design issues and performance
Auxiliary magnetic disk, magnetic tape and optical disks

units.title: Input/Output Organization
topics: Peripheral devices, I/O interface and I/O ports
Interrupt hardware, types of interrupts and exceptions

subjects.name: Discrete Structures and Theory of Logic

units.title: Set Theory, Relations, POSETs and Lattices
topics: Set theory introduction and combination of sets
Equality, recursive definition and order of relations
Partially Ordered Sets (POSETs) and Hasse diagrams
Bounded, complemented, distributive, modular and complete lattices

units.title: Functions and Boolean Algebra
topics: Operations on functions and growth of functions
Simplification of Boolean functions and Karnaugh maps

units.title: Theory of Logics
topics: Algebra of propositions and theory of inference
First-order predicate logic and well-formed formulae
Quantifiers and inference theory of predicate logic

units.title: Algebraic Structures
topics: Rings and fields: definitions and elementary properties

units.title: Graphs and Combinatorics
topics: Graph representations, multigraphs and bipartite graphs
Planar graphs, graph isomorphism and homeomorphism
Euler and Hamiltonian paths; graph coloring

units.title: Introduction to Operating Systems
topics: Batch, interactive, time-sharing and real-time systems
Multiprocessor, multiuser, multiprocess and multithreaded systems

units.title: Concurrent Processes
topics: Process concept and principles of concurrency
Dining philosophers and sleeping barber problems

units.title: CPU Scheduling and Deadlocks
topics: Process Control Block (PCB), address space and identification
Deadlock prevention, avoidance, detection and recovery

units.title: Memory Management
topics: Bare machine, resident monitor and multiprogramming
Fixed and variable partition memory management
Thrashing, cache organization and locality of reference

units.title: I/O, Disk Scheduling and File Systems
topics: File concepts, organization and access mechanisms

subjects.name: Theory of Automata and Formal Languages

units.title: Basic Concepts and Automata Theory
topics: Theory of computation: automata, computability and complexity
Alphabet, symbol, string and formal languages
Deterministic Finite Automaton (DFA): definition, representation and acceptance
Non-deterministic Finite Automaton (NFA) and DFA/NFA equivalence
ε-transition NFA and equivalence with ordinary NFA
Moore and Mealy machines and their equivalence

units.title: Regular Expressions and Languages
topics: Regular and non-regular languages; closure properties
Decision properties of finite automata and regular languages

units.title: Grammars and Context-Free Languages
topics: Conversion between finite automata and grammars
Greibach Normal Form (GNF) and Chomsky hierarchy
Programming problems based on CFG properties

units.title: Pushdown Automata
topics: Nondeterministic Pushdown Automata (NPDA): definition and moves
Deterministic PDA and deterministic context-free languages
PDA for context-free languages and conversion from CFG
Pumping lemma, closure and decision problems for CFLs
Programming problems based on CFL properties

units.title: Turing Machines and Recursive Function Theory
topics: Universal Turing machine and Linear Bounded Automata
Halting problem and Post correspondence problem

units.title: Java Foundations, OOP, Packages and Exceptions
topics: Java history, JVM, JRE, environment, source files and compilation
Classes, constructors, methods and access specifiers
Static and final members, comments, types, variables and operators
Classes, objects, inheritance and method overriding/overloading
Encapsulation, polymorphism, abstraction, interfaces and abstract classes
Packages, CLASSPATH, JAR files and import conventions
Exceptions and errors; exception types and JVM reaction
try, catch, finally, throw and throws; checked and unchecked exceptions

units.title: Java I/O and Multithreading
topics: Reading and writing files in Java

units.title: Java Language Features
topics: Functional interfaces, lambda expressions and method references
Java Module System and diamond syntax with inner anonymous classes
Text blocks, records and sealed classes

units.title: Java Collections Framework
topics: Collection framework hierarchy, Iterator and Collection interfaces
List, ArrayList, LinkedList, Vector and Stack
Map, HashMap, LinkedHashMap, TreeMap and Hashtable

units.title: Spring Framework and Spring Boot
topics: Spring Core, dependency injection and inversion of control
Autowiring, annotations and bean lifecycle callbacks
Spring Boot build systems, structure, runners and logging
RESTful web services and REST controllers
Request mapping, body, path variables and request parameters
GET, POST, PUT and DELETE APIs
